artifactId.description: The derived body-text artifact — what document.classify/validate/stamp actually read, same as any other channel.

originalArtifactId.description: The immutable raw MIME message, unchanged — evidence/audit and GET /workflow/:id/attachment/:n, never a capability's input.

attachmentArtifactIds.description: One derived text artifact per e-mail attachment that could be read (best-effort — a failed one is simply absent here, not zeroed out).

subject.description: Data, never interpreted. Truncated to 200 characters.
